🕉️ Ayush History — Dashvidha Pariksha

Ten-fold Ayurvedic clinical examination, plus diet and lifestyle (Ahara-Vihara) assessment.

1. Prakriti (Constitution)

Baseline doshic constitution determined at birth.

2. Vikriti (Current Imbalance)

Present doshic derangement, as distinct from baseline Prakriti.

3. Sara (Tissue Excellence)

Which dhatu (tissue) shows the greatest excellence/quality.

4. Samhanan (Body Compactness)

Firmness/compactness of body build and joints.

5. Pramana (Body Measurement)

Anthropometric proportion of the body.

6. Satmya (Suitability)

What the patient is habituated/adapted to tolerate well.

7. Sattva (Psychic Strength)

Mental resilience and psychological strength.

8. Ahara Shakti (Digestive Capacity)

Capacity for food intake and digestion/metabolism.

9. Vyayama Shakti (Exercise Capacity)

Tolerance for physical exertion.

10. Vaya (Age Classification)

Ayurvedic age category — auto-suggested from age entered earlier, editable.

11. Ahara-Vihara (Diet & Lifestyle)

Dietary habits and daily routine assessment.
